summary: GeoPark Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, a routine periodic report. The filing discloses a US$25 million break-up fee received from the terminated acquisition of Frontera Energy's E&P assets and transaction costs related to a strategic equity investment by Grupo Gilinski. However, these items are historical disclosures within financial statements, not the subject of a current special-situations filing. No transaction, tender, or strategic process is being announced in this document; it is a standard earnings-related report.
